description: Read one conversation from this channel's message log, newest first: a person or a group. For a person, both of their WhatsApp addresses (phone number and LID) are read as one timeline where the channel holds the lid_lookup grant; `merge` says whether that happened, and each message's `source_chat` says which address it came from. In a group, each sender is one identity (`sender_jid`, with `sender_lid` beside it). Pages hold up to `limit` messages (default 50); when `next_before` is present, pass it as `before` to read the next, older page. Only messages captured while the channel was connected are present, plus history the phone sent if the channel stores it (`source: history_sync`). Every page read is recorded in the channel's API access records.

before.description: The next_before value of a previous page, exactly as returned.

chat.description: The chat: a JID such as 15551234567@s.whatsapp.net or 120363000000000000@g.us, or a phone number in international form. Use chat_jid values from list_chats.

name: read_messages
title: Read a conversation
